source_review.notes: Checked active NASA-HDBK-1009A; final OMG SysML 2.0; active NASA-STD-7009B and the current NASA standards index listing NASA-HDBK-7009B (2026); current NASA Technical Assessment, Decision Analysis and Technical Data Management guidance; NIST TN 1297 and its uncertainty-propagation appendix; and NASA Cost Estimating Handbook Appendix G. All ten final URLs returned HTTP 200. Claims are bounded to calculation/constraint semantics, quantities/units, model credibility, uncertainty/covariance, technical indicators, decision analysis and controlled data provenance.

evidence: Reviewed configured input/output equations, inequality constraints, dimensional compatibility, first-order covariance propagation, quantitative property tuple, maximum/minimum margin conventions, percent denominator, constraint residual and sensitivity coefficient.
Confirmed quantity kind, unit, source/status, configuration, mode/time, uncertainty and version remain explicit.
Confirmed local linear uncertainty propagation is bounded by smoothness, input credibility and dependence assumptions.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The notation separates mathematical relations from solver workflow, value authority, physical meaning and intended-use credibility.

evidence: Executed parametric-budget-point-check and independently recomputed mass 42+88+30=160 kg, 175 kg limit, 15 kg margin and 8.6 percent of limit.
Recomputed power 120+80+60=260 W, 320 W supply and 60 W point margin.
Recomputed energy 260 W times 2 h=520 Wh, 600 Wh declared usable capacity and 80 Wh point margin.
Confirmed zero negative point margins and declared_budgets_within_limits exact output.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The computation deliberately excludes uncertainty, losses, transients, duty changes, temperature, aging, correlation and validation; no probability of compliance is implied.

evidence: Confirmed calculation maps and constraint predicates remain distinct and solver direction is not inferred from equality alone.
Confirmed addition/subtraction requires compatible dimensions while products/quotients compose dimensions and affine/reference conversions need special handling.
Confirmed covariance cross terms can raise or lower propagated variance depending on sensitivities and dependence, so independence is not automatically conservative.
Confirmed maximum/minimum margin sign and percent denominator are separately defined and numerical solver tolerance is not treated as engineering margin.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Budget composition is explicitly allowed to be additive, maximum, RSS, probabilistic, conditional or nonlinear according to the system mechanism.

evidence: Challenged untyped numbers, mass/force and power/energy confusion, affine temperature, pressure/frame/time/currency bases, sign and zero-denominator percentages.
Reviewed duplicate binding, stale cross-tool copies, parent-child double count, omitted boundary flows/losses, incorrect composition, hidden reserve and point-margin confidence claims.

Reviewed mode/transient behavior, common-factor correlation, epistemic/variability/model-form uncertainty, first-order failure, distribution assumptions, tail behavior and Monte Carlo sample/model limits.
Reviewed algebraic loops, scaling, initialization, infeasibility, multiple solutions, discontinuity, residuals, iteration-limit output, sensitivity and identifiability.
Reviewed calibration leakage, extrapolation, surrogate domain, excessive digits, supplier changes, validation discrepancy and dashboard/source authority.
Reviewed all ten examples and five answers for semantics, configured provenance, uncertainty, solver evidence, validation and decision/change control.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Consequential parametric conclusions still require applicable domain, measurement, modeling/simulation, numerical, statistics, uncertainty, supplier, operations, safety, security, verification, validation, risk and decision-authority review.

evidence: Traced intended use, baseline/configuration, mode/environment, model/tool versions, input cutoff, solver and output ownership throughout.
Confirmed requirement, allocation, estimate, measurement, assumption, calibration parameter, reserve, tolerance, uncertainty and margin remain distinct.
Confirmed bindings, dimensional checks, composition/conservation, behavior dependence and correlation precede margin conclusions.
Confirmed convergence, residual, infeasibility/multiplicity, sensitivity, calibration, independent validation and verification retain separate evidence.

invariant_checking.notes: Arithmetic correctness is treated as one necessary layer within semantic, computational and empirical credibility.

proof_review.notes: The chapter presents calculation and propagation relations but no theorem proof.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Reviewed measured, estimated, calibrated, validated, accurate, converged, feasible, compliant, within limits, positive margin, robust, representative and confident language for evidence scope.
artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-055/report.json records exact local execution evidence for three point budgets and declared inputs only.
The chapter requires independent configured validation referents, metrics, domain and discrepancy evidence before intended-use model claims.
A green constraint, solver number, calibration fit, large sample or matching spreadsheet is never presented as proof of physical truth or decision confidence.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No external review is claimed, and the checker establishes neither uncertainty-aware compliance nor actual system performance.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked parametric model, quantity kind/unit, value property, calculation, constraint, binding, budget, limit, allocation, estimate, measurement, margin, reserve, tolerance, uncertainty, sensitivity, identifiability, calibration, validation, covariance and solver configuration. These categories remain consistently distinct.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked use framing, quantity semantics, value classes, calculation/predicate direction, binding, units, sign/margin, budgets, conservation, behavior-dependent properties, uncertainty/dependence, propagation, solvers, identifiability, sensitivity, calibration/validation, implementation verification, surrogates, reporting and change. Cases cover units, offsets, correlation, transients, nonlinear loops, data leakage, double count, extrapolation, reserve and field discrepancy.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from property semantics through coupled budgets, uncertainty/computation, credibility and decision lifecycle. Ten examples and five complete solutions require learners to upgrade a point budget, repair a misleading model, design a cold-start battery analysis, validate a public-service queue model and govern a supplier-driven margin change.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic, practitioner, domain, measurement, modeling/simulation, numerical-methods, statistics, uncertainty, supplier, operations, safety, security, verification, validation, risk, or decision-authority review is claimed.
